kpis.description_fr: Adjusted Funds From Operations par action FY24. Métrique reine REIT triple-net (mesure cashflow distribuable). Croissance régulière.
kpis.description_en: Adjusted Funds From Operations per share FY24. Key REIT triple-net metric (measures distributable cash flow). Steady growth.

kpis.description_fr: Propriétés gaming et hospitality détenues fin FY24. Portefeuille concentré Las Vegas Strip (Caesars Palace, MGM Grand, Venetian) + régional. Croissance via M&A (Pinnacle, MGP).
kpis.description_en: Gaming and hospitality properties held end FY24. Portfolio concentrated Las Vegas Strip (Caesars Palace, MGM Grand, Venetian) + regional. Growth via M&A (Pinnacle, MGP).

kpis.description_fr: Taux d'occupation 100% sur toutes les propriétés grâce aux baux triple-net long terme (15-40 ans). Caractéristique structurelle du modèle.
kpis.description_en: 100% occupancy across all properties thanks to triple-net long-term leases (15-40 years). Structural feature of the model.

kpis.description_fr: Durée moyenne pondérée des baux restants. Visibilité revenue exceptionnellement longue (40+ ans). Sécurité cash flow.
kpis.description_en: Weighted average remaining lease term. Exceptionally long revenue visibility (40+ years). Cash flow security.

kpis.description_fr: Loyer de base annualisé contractuel FY24. Cash flow ultra-prévisible (escalators CPI inclus dans baux). Pilier du dividende.
kpis.description_en: Contractual annualized base rent FY24. Ultra-predictable cash flow (CPI escalators built into leases). Dividend foundation.

kpis_story.description_fr: Diversification hors casino vers sports (Chelsea Piers, Top Golf), wellness, bowling. Réduit dépendance gaming concentrée.
kpis_story.description_en: Diversification beyond casinos into sports (Chelsea Piers, Top Golf), wellness, bowling. Reduces concentrated gaming dependence.

_notes: Gaming/experiential REIT. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Feb 2025.
